description: An empty-body definite rule with head \(p\) is satisfied exactly when \(p\) is true, and an empty-body constraint is never satisfied.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.empty_rules.{u} {α : Type u} (p : α) (X : Set α) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.Holds { body := ∅, head := some p } X ↔ p ∈ X) ∧
    ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.Holds { body := ∅, head := none } X
